method.D_requirement: threshold strictly above the kth ascending available-D logit
method.E_requirement: threshold at most the kth descending available-E logit
method.feasibility: all original capacities sufficient and max strict D bound < min inclusive E bound
method.U: original unavailable inputs remain U in original known-class denominators
method.required_counts: smallest integer k with original Python k/N>=unchanged limit; no rounding of gates
